evidence_stage: v101.51 - three fixes on top of the v101.49 production build, all reported by Louis on his own devices. (1) v101.50: iOS Safari auto-zooms the page whenever a text field with a font under 16px is focused and never zooms back out, which left the app permanently wider than the screen and pannable sideways after opening a note; the note textarea (14.4px) and the Approfondir section search (15.2px) are now 16px, and pinch-zoom is deliberately left enabled. (2) v101.51: Mon Espace sorted highlights by passage label and rendered only the first 8, so labels beginning with a letter - Priere and Complement - always fell off the end and could never be seen; the list is now ordered newest-first and the cap became a preview with a 'Voir mes N surlignages' expander. Notes carried the same silent cap and got the same expander. (3) v101.49's selection-bar Note button and stale-highlight recovery are carried forward unchanged. Corpus untouched since v101.44: all six protected declarations verify byte-identical against the v101.44 hash contract.
real_device_status: CONFIRMED - Louis tested the note-panel zoom fix and Mon Espace highlight visibility on iPhone before this promotion.
